ns2:section.sectionText: Students must have an internship lined up before requesting permission for this course and must submit a report to the instructor at the end of the term. International students should request permission by completing the CPT e-form from ISSS, selecting the Math 399 instructor as advisor, and then emailing the instructor with 9-digit UIN and Math 399 request if ISSS approves the CPT. Those without a student visa may contact the instructor directly.
